title: Detailed paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="skyGlow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4FC3F7"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#29B6F6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="planeBody" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF9C4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFD54F"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="planeWing" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFF0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFE082"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="planeShadow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFC107"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF8F00"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Motion trail dashes -->
  <g stroke="#4FC3F7" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.55">
    <line x1="18" y1="62" x2="30" y2="58"/>
    <line x1="12" y1="72" x2="24" y2="68"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="82" x2="32" y2="78"/>
    <line x1="8" y1="52" x2="18" y2="49"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Paper plane main body (top surface) -->
  <polygon points="55,22 30,72 58,52" fill="url(#planeBody)" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- Paper plane right wing (main visible wing) -->
  <polygon points="55,22 92,50 58,52" fill="url(#planeWing)" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- Paper plane left wing (folded under, darker) -->
  <polygon points="55,22 30,72 48,60 58,52" fill="url(#planeShadow)" stroke="#FF8F00" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- Fold crease line down the center -->
  <line x1="55" y1="22" x2="58" y2="52" stroke="#FF8F00" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Fold detail line on right wing -->
  <line x1="55" y1="22" x2="75" y2="46" stroke="#FFE082" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Fold detail line on left body -->
  <line x1="55" y1="22" x2="40" y2="64" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Nose highlight -->
  <circle cx="55" cy="23" r="1.5" fill="#FFFDE7"/>

  <!-- Wing tip highlight -->
  <circle cx="91" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#FFFDE7"/>

  <!-- Small sparkle stars around plane -->
  <g fill="#FFFDE7">
    <polygon points="42,30 43,32 45,32 43.5,33.5 44,36 42,34.5 40,36 40.5,33.5 39,32 41,32"/>
    <polygon points="72,28 72.8,30 75,30 73.2,31.5 73.8,34 72,32.5 70.2,34 70.8,31.5 69,30 71.2,30"/>
    <polygon points="78,62 78.8,64 81,64 79.2,65.5 79.8,68 78,66.5 76.2,68 76.8,65.5 75,64 77.2,64"/>
    <polygon points="35,45 35.6,46.5 37.2,46.5 36,47.5 36.4,49.2 35,48.2 33.6,49.2 34,47.5 32.8,46.5 34.4,46.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Dotted flight path curve -->
  <path d="M 12,80 Q 30,70 45,65 Q 60,58 70,35" fill="none" stroke="#81D4FA" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="2,4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
